desc:
[🌟]Welcome to My Summer Car [MULTIPLAYER]
(ROBLOX fan-solo-project-game of original game "My Summer Car" that you can buy on steam! This game DOESN'T HAVE any gamepasses that you need to PURCHASE to play the full game)

M - Options and Cheats
NOTE: I recommend you to create a private server for free to play with your friends!

[🚗] You can assemble a car with your own hands and drive around a huge map, while looking at beautiful nature!
[💼] Work at different jobs and get money for making up your car!
[🍖] Don't forget about your needs, because you need to buy food, drink water and more to survive!
[🌍] This game provides lots of different sound effects and details so you can feel the atmosphere!
[🚩] This game also provides lots of different activities and tasks that you can complete so you won't get bored!

This game is not official "My Summer Car" by Amistech games!
